info.title: ZTE F6600P firmware HTTP RPC reference
info.description: Independent, source-derived research for firmware V9.0.10P6N6. Not affiliated with ZTE or an ISP. The actual HTTP API dispatches through / using _type and _tag. This spec does not invent REST paths. See x-router-handlers and endpoints.md for per-handler operation/schema evidence. Candidate schemas are not a guarantee of server validation or permissions. Active GETs can change operational state. No private installation data is included.

servers.description: Reserved placeholder: configure your own router explicitly.

get.summary: Dispatch a page, passive read or explicitly selected active GET
get.description: Use the matching handler/page context in x-router-handlers. In particular, wlan_sta_wlan_profile_lua.lua?APGetFrom=ScanAP or ScanAP5g initiates scanning and is NOT a passive read. Some handlers need additional query parameters. HTTP 200 can contain SessionTimeout or an HTML error.

200.description: XML/JSON data, HTML page, or an application-level error. Validate format/status inside the response.

post.summary: Dispatch login/logout, preferences or an explicit firmware action
post.description: Authenticated data writes require a fresh page token and RSA-wrapped SHA-256 Check header over the EXACT form body. Password controls marked by response encode metadata require AES-CBC and wrapped encode key material. Do not retry writes automatically. Query selectors and schema variants must be paired using x-router-handlers. Login/logout use their separately documented payloads, not generic IF_ACTION.

parameters.name: Check
parameters.description: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 encrypted hexadecimal SHA-256 of exact form body, base64 encoded.

200.description: Parse IF_ERRORSTR/IF_ERRORID/IF_ERRORTYPE, not only HTTP status. Fresh GET verification is required after mutations.
